claims.claim: At a dinner at the Time Traveller's house he explains time as a fourth dimension to Filby, the Psychologist and the Medical Man; they are sceptical
claims.evidence: 'Really this is what is meant by the Fourth Dimension'; 'It's against reason,' said Filby; 'though it's all humbug, you know'

claims.claim: He shows a small model time machine
claims.evidence: 'this is only a model. It is my plan for a machine to travel through time'; the Psychologist sent the model into the air

claims.claim: A week later he tells them he built a full-size machine and travelled to the year 802,701
claims.evidence: 'The next Thursday I went again to Richmond'; 'Eight Hundred and Two Thousand Seven Hundred and One, A.D.'

claims.claim: He finds the gentle, childlike Eloi
claims.evidence: 'the same soft hairless visage, and the same girlish rotundity of limb'; 'extremely precocious'; no lasting work or struggle
'I caught the poor mite and drew her safe to land'; 'Weena' named at line 1533
'Why had the Morlocks taken my Time Machine?'

claims.claim: The Morlocks are pale, ape-like underground creatures that feed on the Eloi
claims.evidence: 'ape-like creature'; 'dull white'; 'These Eloi were mere fatted cattle'
the Eloi above ground and Morlocks below (chapter 'The Morlocks')

claims.claim: He and Weena flee through a forest fire, which kills her
claims.evidence: 'I felt the intensest wretchedness for the horrible death of little Weena'; she is lost in the burning forest

claims.claim: He regains the machine and travels far ahead to a dying Earth
claims.evidence: 'the same red sun... the same dying sea'; crab-like creatures

claims.claim: After telling his story he leaves on another trip and never comes back
claims.evidence: 'The Time Traveller was not there... The Time Machine had gone'; 'The Time Traveller vanished three years ago'

claims.claim: The narrator is left with two white flowers

claims.evidence: Text calls her 'little Weena', 'the poor mite', a drowning child-sized figure; 'woman' not stated
claims.fix: a little Eloi he rescues from drowning

claims.evidence: 'The Time Traveller (for so it will be convenient to speak of him)'
